summary: I implemented or repaired a large set of skeleton stubs: regression (elastic-net fit_regularized and ridge, burg, summary, get_prediction, WLS/centered-TSS fixes), formula (handle_formula_data, formula-aware predict, hypothesis matrices), duration (survival helpers and survdiff), stats (qsturng/psturng via scipy, describe), tools (grouputils, testing exports) and assorted helpers, but large stubbed areas remain (ARDL, ARIMA specification, statespace MLEModel, HAC/sandwich, LM tests, survival kernel estimates). The last full-suite run I saw had 6191 passed, 6874 failed and 3369 errors, and a targeted rerun showed about 58 MNLogit tests in discrete that passed at the start now fail, with the cause not isolated.
